written.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
written.summary: Anthropic became a public company on Thursday, raising $81.3 billion in an initial public offering that included $1.95 billion for its seven founders. The stock closed at $97.17 per share, giving the company a valuation of roughly $1.7 trillion.

written.headline: Anthropic's Claude model solves two open problems in black hole physics
written.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in black hole physics, including a calculation left unresolved for over 20 years. The model showed that black hole formation in very small universes happens through a sudden first-order phase transition.

written.headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
written.summary: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent designed to browse the web, work across apps, write code, and call services, according to a job listing. The project would put Apple in competition with similar AI assistants from Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

written.headline: Nvidia in talks to acquire diffusion LLM startup Inception for $500M+
written.summary: Nvidia is in advanced talks to acquire diffusion LLM developer Inception for over $500 million plus earnouts. The discussions began prior to Jensen Huang's resignation.

written.headline: Google adds computer use to Gemini for macOS
written.summary: Google added a computer use feature to the Gemini desktop app on macOS, enabling the AI to complete tasks across apps, files, and the web in the background. The feature is available in English to U.S. AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers.

written.headline: Students sue school and police after chip bag triggers AI gun alert
written.summary: Four high school students sued Baltimore County Public Schools, the police department, and Omnilert after an AI gun-detection system mistook a bag of chips for a firearm in October 2025. Despite school officials canceling the alert within two minutes, armed police were dispatched, resulting in the students being handcuffed and searched on campus.
